description: This file defines classes and functions for handling database schema generation and manipulation based on XML schema descriptions within the ADOdb library. It includes classes for database objects, tables, indexes, data, SQL query sets, and the overall schema processing and parsing logic.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common methods for database schema objects such as support platform checks, prefix handling, and destruction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a parent reference and optional attributes.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Callback for processing start XML elements.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Callback for processing character data within XML elements.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Callback for processing end XML elements.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method to create schema object; default returns empty array.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Method to destroy the object; meant for cleanup.

methods.name: supportedPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the current platform supports the specified RDBMS platform.

methods.name: prefix
methods.description: Returns the object prefix, delegating to parent if available.

methods.name: FieldID
methods.description: Converts a field name to an uppercase ID, stripping backticks.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, including schema parsing, creation SQL generation, and support for indexes, fields, and data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a table object, setting name with prefix.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Processes start tags such as INDEX, DROP, FIELD, KEY, DEFAULT, etc., within the table XML.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Processes CDATA content for constraints and options.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles closing tags and finalizes object state.

methods.name: addIndex
methods.description: Creates and adds an index object to the table.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Creates and adds data objects (rows) to the table.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field (column) definition with type, size, and options.

methods.name: addFieldOpt
methods.description: Adds a specific option to a field.

methods.name: addTableOpt
methods.description: Adds a table-level option.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create or alter the table schema.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Marks the table or a field for dropping/deletion.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a table index, with methods for adding fields, options, and generating creation SQL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes index with parent and attributes.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Processes index-specific XML tags such as DROP, CLUSTERED, and COL.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Processes CDATA content such as column names.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles closing tags.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a column to the index.

methods.name: addIndexOpt
methods.description: Adds an option to the index.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates SQL to create the index.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Marks the index for dropping.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Represents data rows for a table, supporting parsing from XML and generating insert SQL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes with a parent reference.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Processes start tags such as ROW and F for data rows and fields.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Processes text content for data fields.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles closing tags for data elements.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Defines a new data field in the current row.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds data content to the current field.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates SQL INSERT statements for the stored data.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Represents a set of SQL queries, allowing incremental building and processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes with parent and attributes, manages query prefixes.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Processes 'QUERY' tags and starts a new SQL query.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Builds the SQL query from CDATA content.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Finalizes queries and triggers creation.

methods.name: newQuery
methods.description: Resets the current query.

methods.name: discardQuery
methods.description: Discards the current in-progress query.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Appends SQL lines to the current query.

methods.name: addQuery
methods.description: Stores the current query into the set.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Returns SQL queries with object prefixes applied.

methods.name: prefixQuery
methods.description: Helper to add prefixes to object names in SQL.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Represents a schema object that can parse, generate, and transform XML database schemas. It handles loading schemas, converting versions, and applying schemas to databases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes schema with a database connection, sets defaults.

methods.name: SetUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets the upgrade method for existing schemas.

methods.name: ExecuteInline
methods.description: Enables/disables executing SQL inline during schema parsing.

methods.name: ContinueOnError
methods.description: Enables/disables continuing schema execution on errors.

methods.name: ParseSchema
methods.description: Loads XML schema from file and generates SQL.

methods.name: ParseSchemaFile
methods.description: Loads XML schema from file (deprecated).

methods.name: ParseSchemaString
methods.description: Loads schema from XML string and generates SQL.

methods.name: RemoveSchema
methods.description: Generates SQL to remove schema.

methods.name: RemoveSchemaString
methods.description: Same as above but for XML string.

methods.name: ExecuteSchema
methods.description: Applies the accumulated schema SQL to the database.

methods.name: PrintSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements in specified format.

methods.name: SaveSQL
methods.description: Saves the SQL statements to a file.

methods.name: create_parser
methods.description: Creates an XML parser with specific handlers.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Processes start tags for many schema elements.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Processes character data; often ignored.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles closing tags.

methods.name: SchemaFileVersion
methods.description: Reads schema version from a file.

methods.name: SchemaStringVersion
methods.description: Reads schema version from a string.

methods.name: ExtractSchema
methods.description: Exports current database schema to XML.

methods.name: SetPrefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix for object names.

methods.name: prefix
methods.description: Applies the prefix to a name.

methods.name: supportedPlatform
methods.description: Checks if a platform is supported.

methods.name: clearSQL
methods.description: Clears stored SQL statements.

methods.name: addSQL
methods.description: Appends SQL statements with optional execution.

methods.name: getSQL
methods.description: Returns stored SQL in format.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleanup before destroying schema object.
